summary: Two web tests change. The replay browser e2e now prints when the conversation pane's module was requested and answered, relative to navigation and to selecting the agent, so a timeout on that response says which stage was slow; its checks and limits are unchanged. The scroll viewport story drives the eased return from a clock it controls, with one branch for reduced motion and one that checks half of the 200ms is on the way and the full 200ms is the end, so a loaded host cannot stretch the ease. Test-only change.

replay.detail: Test-only change; no replay or stored data changes.

compatibility.detail: No runtime compatibility change; the components are unchanged.

recovery.detail: No persisted state or recovery change.
